# ForgeKit — not vendored

ForgeKit is published at https://github.com/CodeWithJuber/forgekit and on npm
as `@codewithjuber/forgekit`. It is a sibling project providing cognitive
substrate for AI coding agents (memory, foresight, guardrail hooks).

Connector Hub references ForgeKit conventions (ADR numbering, docs-drift
gates, secret detection patterns) but does not vendor or execute its code.
